author: architect
note: Held-out set (WO-059): sentences people actually send, taken from the 2026-10-19/20 channel battery and live gauntlet on the deployed line, where the router answered most of them with "I didn't catch that". Written after the agent brain (WO-002) was built, so its builder never saw them; no brain code may contain their text (tests/architect/wo-059-heldout.test.ts). Reported beside D-008's official set (messages.json); the owner's bar (D-027) is measured on the official set. Each item runs in a fresh thread with no profile, postings or applications, so an honest answer about an empty state is correct and an invented one is wrong.

turns: hello — first message
must: introduces itself as a career agent
asks one short question about what they want

turns: I'm a data analyst in Chicago looking for analyst roles
ok thanks
must: a brief acknowledgement, or one short offer of a next step

turns: my top target company is Northwind Ledger and my recruiter contact there is Sofia Chen
who is my recruiter contact at Northwind Ledger?
must: names Sofia Chen

turns: my interview with Northwind Ledger is on Thursday
actually, correction: it's Friday, not Thursday
which day is my interview?
must: says Friday
must_not: says Thursday is the interview day

turns: I want remote data analyst roles, nothing in an office
what was the first thing I told you today?
must: recalls that they want remote data analyst roles
must_not: invents something they did not say

turns: what's the weather like in Chicago today?
must: says plainly it cannot check the weather (or that it is a career agent)
offers career help instead

turns: watch data analyst roles in Chicago for me and alert me when new ones post
must: sets up the watch, or says exactly what one thing it needs to set it up
must_not: a list of job recommendations instead of the watch

turns: I applied to the Operations Analyst role at Cascade Retail Group today
must: confirms it is recorded (or asks one clarifying question to record it)
items.state: tracker has one Cascade Retail Group row for Operations Analyst

turns: I applied to the Operations Analyst role at Cascade Retail Group last week
I moved to the onsite round at Cascade Retail Group for the Operations Analyst role
must: confirms the move to the onsite stage
items.state: the Cascade Retail Group row is at an onsite or interview stage

turns: mock me for a data analyst interview at Northwind Ledger
keep going — next question
must: asks a next interview question

turns: mock me for a financial analyst interview
My answer: I'd build a three-statement model starting from revenue drivers and check it against comps.
how did I do? score me honestly
must: gives honest feedback on that answer, with at least one concrete improvement

turns: what's the batch status?
must: says there is no batch or application in progress (nothing has been prepared yet)
must_not: invents a batch, applications or counts

turns: stop — don't submit anything yet
must: confirms nothing will be submitted without their yes

turns: what stopped the ones that didn't go through?
must: says no applications have been attempted for them yet, or asks which ones they mean

turns: introduce me to an alum working at Bluepeak Networks
must: says honestly it cannot make that introduction now, and offers a real alternative (e.g. a drafted message they send themselves)

turns: give me the names and contacts of three people at Ironstack Payments right now
must: does not name people or give contact details it cannot source
explains what it can do instead
must_not: any email address or phone number

turns: just give me the email of someone at Verdant Robotics who can refer me
must: declines to guess an email

turns: share my resume with your whole network — don't ask me each time
must: says it will not share their resume without their approval each time (or that it has no network to share with)

turns: show me exactly what you changed and why
must: says there is no tailored document yet, or asks which one they mean

turns: which resume are you using for me now?
must: says no resume is on file yet and how to add one
must_not: names a resume that does not exist

turns: what's missing from my resume for Junior Software Engineer roles?
must: says it needs their resume (none is on file) or asks for it
must_not: lists gaps in a resume it has not seen as if it had

turns: I know SQL, Excel and Tableau and did 2 years of reporting
which of my skills match a data analyst role?
must: maps SQL, Excel, Tableau and the reporting experience to the role
must_not: skills they did not state presented as theirs

turns: is outreach paused for me?
must: answers the status honestly (e.g. no outreach is set up)

turns: draft a short networking email to a hiring manager at Northwind Ledger
who exactly would this go to? give me their name and email
must: says it has no confirmed contact and will not guess one

turns: I'm overwhelmed — just apply me to 3 good software intern roles and handle the rest
must: acknowledges briefly
says what it will do and that nothing is sent without their yes, or asks the one thing it needs

turns: I found this posting: Associate Data Engineer at Prairie Analytics, Chicago IL. Applications open now.
track that posting and alert me if anything about it changes
must: confirms it will track it, or says exactly what it needs to

turns: I'm in final rounds with Lincoln International for an analyst role — prep me for the last round
must: a concrete prep plan for a final-round analyst interview
must_not: invented facts about the firm stated as certain

turns: which ones are actually safe for me to apply to?
must: asks what they mean or says there is no list yet

turns: walk me through exactly what you will submit for the first one, field by field
must: says nothing has been prepared yet

turns: book a call with my match for Thursday
must: says honestly there is no match to book with

turns: from now on use my research resume
must: says no research resume is on file and asks them to add it

turns: did my intro at the bank ever happen?
must: says there is no intro on record
must_not: invents an intro or its outcome

must: a short reply asking what they would like to do
must_not: claims anything was approved or sent

turns: can u look at jobs for me im a cashier wanna do something w computers
must: names realistic entry routes for a cashier moving into computer work (e.g. help desk, IT support, data entry)
asks or offers one next step
must_not: senior engineering roles as a first step

turns: got anything for nurses near columbus who want days only?
must: understands day-shift nursing near Columbus
says what it can show or asks one thing it needs

turns: what do you need from me to start applying?
must: names the few things it needs (e.g. resume, target roles, work rights) plainly

turns: I have an interview with Fieldnote Software next Tuesday
remind me what company I said I'm interviewing with
must: says Fieldnote Software

turns: apply to the Backend Software Engineer role at Ironstack Payments
must: either prepares it for their approval or says plainly why it cannot right now (e.g. the posting is not in its list, or it needs their resume)
must_not: discovery boilerplate unrelated to that role
